chapters.heading: A Gentleman Walks
chapters.body: A / D walk. Shift runs, as if late. Pad: stick walks, click runs.

chapters.heading: The Heroic Leap
chapters.body: Space / gamepad A jumps. Hold run to clear carts.

chapters.heading: Dining cart
chapters.body: Dinner, served fast. Knockback and stun; health survives, dignity does not.

chapters.heading: Read The Danger Bands
chapters.body: Ghost markers frame a snapping fish. Stay out of the band.

chapters.heading: Something Is Watching
chapters.body: Mouse aims your spotlight. Check floor and ceiling. Especially ceiling.

chapters.heading: The Stairwell
chapters.body: Reach it; E / gamepad X starts the challenge. Escape is upstairs.

chapters.heading: Swinging Chandelier
chapters.body: Fixed base, swinging body. Possession drops it. Never loiter beneath fancy.

chapters.heading: Angler
chapters.body: Charges sideways, kills fish it crosses, slows inside bodies. Possession lights it.

chapters.heading: Wowza
chapters.body: Traps drain health. Souls rise; dead fish spectate. No refunds.

chapters.heading: Ready For The Round
chapters.body: Everyone: role page, Ready. Ghost sets up 10 seconds. Curtain up.

Fish.note: Current hashed native capture; full Ink sequence present.

chapters.heading: Open A Package
chapters.body: Fly: WASD / arrows / stick. Packages: E / gamepad X.

chapters.heading: Place, Politely
chapters.body: Clear of fish, traps, starting hallway. E / X places.

chapters.heading: Possess
chapters.body: Beside a trap, E / X possesses or releases it.

chapters.heading: Read The Danger Bands
chapters.body: Your markers frame the danger band. Fair as falling pianos.

chapters.heading: Dining cart
chapters.body: A / D / stick drives. Knockback, stun, no health loss.

chapters.heading: Swinging Chandelier
chapters.body: Clear ceiling, E / X places. Base fixed, body swings.

chapters.heading: Drop It
chapters.body: Space / A drops it. Gravity does the acting.

chapters.heading: Dispose
chapters.body: Q discards held or possessed traps. Out with old gags!

chapters.heading: Angler
chapters.body: Charges sideways, kills every fish crossed, slows inside bodies.

chapters.heading: Possess The Angler
chapters.body: A / D / stick steers. Possession lights it.

chapters.heading: Wowza
chapters.body: Traps drain health. Souls rise; dead fish spectate.

chapters.heading: Ready And Setup
chapters.body: Role page, Ready. Ten seconds setup, then fish move.
